title: The Two Travelers and the Bear
summary: When a bear appeared, one traveler deserted his friend and climbed a tree. The second played dead on the grass....
keywords: the two travelers and the bear
full_text:
When a bear appeared, one traveler deserted his friend and climbed a tree. The second played dead on the grass.

The bear sniffed him and left.

The man in the tree asked what the bear had murmured. "He warned me never to trust a comrade who flies when danger strikes!"
moral: Adversity separates false flatterers from true companions.
